# Microsoft Agent Framework

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
pip install "maxey0-superspace[microsoft] @ git+https://github.com/mmc7676/Maxey0"
```

The `agent-framework` package is an *optional* dependency and is never vendored. The adapter imports it at the moment it is used, so a build that does not use this harness does not import it.

Covers AutoGen and Semantic Kernel through the same binding.

## What this is

- `maxey0_ss/adapters/harnesses/microsoft.py`

## Identity

- product `Maxey0-SuperSpace`
- MCP namespace `maxey0-ss` — every tool and resource
